title: ChatGPT Voice Mode

body.text: talk to ChatGPT by voice in real time
— you can interrupt and change topics mid-conversation. Great while driving, cooking, or practicing a language with a conversation partner that never gets bored.

example: "Practice an English job interview with me — ask one question at a time, then give feedback on my pronunciation and answers"

title: Make the most of Voice Mode

body.text: practicing a language, rehearsing a presentation, brainstorming on the go, and Q&A when your hands are full
— state the role at the start of the conversation, just like a normal prompt, to give the chat direction.

example: "Pretend to be a hesitant customer; I'll practice my insurance pitch — ask hard questions, then assess how well I answered"
